give-jd-deep-security-check-deep-securit.description: Use when the user asks for a defensive security assessment, security audit, vulnerability scan, or "how safe / how reliable is this code/project/repo". Runs Semgrep (SAST), osv-scanner (dependency CVEs) and gitleaks (secrets) against a local project, then produces a report with a reproducible reliability grade (0-100, A-F). Defensive only — finds weaknesses in code you own; it does not exploit, attack, or test remote targets.
